name: B10-0466/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1925/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards monacolins from red yeast rice
part_text:
The European Parliament is against a planned European Commission rule that would ban monacolins from red yeast rice in food and food supplements. These substances can lower cholesterol. The Parliament says the Commission did not properly check whether lighter measures, such as labels, quality controls and limits on daily intake, would protect consumers just as well. It asks the Commission to withdraw the plan and bring a new one.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only states its opposition and asks for the plan to be withdrawn.
- **Who it affects:** People who take red yeast rice supplements to manage cholesterol, and the companies selling them.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to withdraw the plan, wait for pending court rulings, and assess the impact first.
